fileIndex.title: File Search
fileIndex.serviceDescription: Once enabled, you can search files in "Universal Search". The search speed in "Files" will also be improved
fileIndex.maintenanceDescription: If search results are incomplete, you can rebuild the index
fileIndex.fileNameSearchSubscription: It is the foundation of all indexing services and can not be disabled individually
fileIndex.fileContentSearchSubscription: Create document content indexes, supporting searching for texts in documents (supports common document formats)
fileIndex.semanticSearchSubscription: Create document semantic indexes, allowing to understand and search based on the core concepts of documents
fileIndex.imageTextSearchSubscription: Create image text indexes, supporting recognizing and searching for texts in images or PDFs
fileIndex.modalOpenIndexServiceContent: This action will enable indexing services for all files on your hard drive. The process will consume moderate system resources and the duration depends on the number of files
fileIndex.modalCloseIndexServiceContent: After disabling, you cannot search for files in "Universal Search". The existing indexed data will be retained
fileIndex.modalOpenFileContentSearchContent: This action will create an document content index. The duration depends on the number of files
fileIndex.modalCloseFileContentSearchContent: After disabling, content search will be unavailable and existing indexes will be retained
fileIndex.modalOpenImageTextSearchContent: This action will create an image text recognition index. The duration depends on the number of files
fileIndex.modalCloseImageTextSearchContent: After disabling, OCR search will be unavailable and existing indexes will be retained
fileIndex.modalOpenSemanticSearchContent: This action will create a sematic index. The duration depends on the number of files
fileIndex.modalCloseSemanticSearchContent: After disabling, document semantic search (AI) will be unavailable and existing indexes will be retained
fileIndex.modalOcrDisabledContent: OCR model service is not enabled. Please go to "AI Console" to enable it and try again
fileIndex.modalAiDisabledContent: Document semantic vectorization model is not enabled. Please go to "AI Console" to enable it and try again
fileIndex.modalRebuildIndexContent: This action will clear all indexes and rebuild them. Please note that this process may take a while

searchRangeMenu.topTips: Once enabled, relevant content from the app can be searched in "Universal Search" app

excludeFolderSetting.topTips: Folders added to this list will not be indexed by the system and included content will not appear in the results
